name: Men's Class A coat senior member officer layer: epaulets with gray epaulet sleeves, US lapel insignia, 1/2 in blue sleeve braid (overlay, blank grade)
size_basis: Sleeve braid width 0.5 in and 3 in from the sleeve end per CAPR 39-1 4.1.5.2 / 4.1.9.2; epaulet width and length estimated from DAFI 36-2903 Figs 4.6-4.7 and the cadet board strips; US insignia size estimated. Braid tone sampled from CAPR 39-1 (3 Mar 2020) rendered at 3x: Fig 4.6 PDF p64 (p.36) braid 2.3,33.1,86.2 / 2.7,31.9,84.3; Fig 4.1 PDF p54 (p.26) 2.1,32.3,83.6; Fig 4.7a PDF p73 (p.45) 2.1,32.4,84.6; coat 0,40,101. Drawn as 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch, tones = coat navy x RATIO.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box
documented: officers wear the coat with epaulets and embroidered grade on gray epaulet sleeves (CAPR 39-1 4.1.5.2, 4.1.5.2.1.1 / 4.1.9.2, 4.1.9.3.1)
US lapel insignia halfway up the seam, resting on but not over it, no circle (4.1.5.2.2.1.1 / 4.1.9.4.1.1)
1/2 in blue sleeve braid 3 in from the end of the sleeve (4.1.5.2 / 4.1.9.2)
grade insignia 5/8 in from the end of the epaulet, parallel with the sleeve seam (DAFI 36-2903 4.5.1.1.1)

sleeve_braid.rule: lower edge parallel to the drawn cuff edge and 3.0 in from it (CAPR 39-1 4.1.5.2), measured perpendicular to the cuff edge on each sleeve

assumed: braid colour: no shade specified for the Class A coat; tone sampled from the CAPR 39-1 figures 4.6 / 4.7a (see base-art/braid-art.js)
rank insignia not drawn: placed by the rank insignia assets at rank_slot
